ios.desc:
PlanEat - smart meal planning and healthy eating

Tired of asking what to cook tonight? PlanEat makes meal planning simple and realistic. Create a weekly meal plan or a monthly menu plan, get easy recipes for everyday cooking, and keep a clean grocery list that matches your menu. PlanEat works as a menu planner, a dinner planner, and a food planner for busy people who still want healthy eating and eating well.

Why PlanEat

* Personal meal planning that fits your life
* Menu plan generator for fast weekly planning
* Smart grocery list that follows your plan and reduces waste
* Meal prep ideas for batch cooking and leftovers
* Clear recipes with simple steps for everyday cooking
* Flexible for different goals: lose weight, gain weight, or maintain
* Works with preferences and dislikes so meals match your taste

How PlanEat helps you every week

* Build a weekly meal plan in minutes and keep it synced with a grocery list
* Use PlanEat as your dinner planner to organize workday dinners and weekend menus
* Treat it like a meal prep planner for batch cooking sessions, including a “meal prep Sunday” flow
* Explore new recipes and keep your favorite recipe ideas together while you plan
* Stay consistent with healthy eating and better nutrition by following a realistic menu plan

Designed for real life

* Healthy meal planner for singles, couples, and families
* Simple cooking steps that reduce stress and save time
* Options for diets and restrictions, including ingredients to avoid and diets like keto
* Ideas for fast breakfasts, easy lunches, and simple dinners

Keywords covered in natural context
PlanEat intentionally focuses on core topics our users search for: meal planning, meal plan creation, menu planner, menu plan, healthy eating, eating well, dinner planner, food planner, grocery list, meal prep, recipe and recipes. Many people want a healthy meal planner that supports different goals like lose weight or gain weight. Others want a keto diet app style of planning without strict tracking. PlanEat is built to support all of these everyday needs in one place.

What makes PlanEat different

* Practical meal planning that is easy to follow day after day
* A single place for menu planning, dinner planning, grocery planning, and recipe ideas
* Nutrition friendly suggestions so healthy eating feels natural
* Routine planner benefits for food habits without the pressure of a strict diet app

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I am Valerii, solo founder of PlanEat AI.

Long days running my startup studio meant dinner was a daily decision loop. I tried popular apps, but none planned a whole week around time limits, allergies, and tastes, then produced one clean list for the store. So I built PlanEat AI.

What it does
• Personalizes a weekly menu to diet, allergies, dislikes, meals per day, and cooking time
• Generates one consolidated shopping list with grouped categories and deduped quantities
• Lets you swap any dish and instantly recalculates the plan, recipes, and list
• Focuses on simple healthy eating, no calorie tracking

Tech
Flutter and Dart, Supabase Postgres and Edge Functions, a small LLM layer for recipe ranking, StoreKit for subscriptions.

Looking for feedback on

Onboarding flow and preference capture

Menu quality for different diets and time budgets

Shopping list grouping and naming

Integrations you would want next

Happy to answer questions and share more details.
